notes:
- Primary contact: Head of Product (Anya Volk) + Platform Lead (Jon Park).
- Use-case: RAG for support agent + ticket deflection, tight latency requirements for customer chat flows.
- Index scale: initial ingestion ~25M tickets + KB pages, target growth to 50M+ over 12 months, incremental updates nightly, some streaming for new tickets.
- Retrieval profile: many short queries (3-6 tokens) followed by rerank + top-5 answers surfaced to agent UI. Aim: top-5 precision high (measured by manual eval / MRR).
- Latency SLOs discussed: retrieval + rerank P95 <= 180ms; end-to-end with model generation P95 <= 600ms for quick follow-ups. Customer emphasized <200ms for the interactive agent path during live chat.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Wants cost per query < $0.015 (including retrieval + rerank + generation) at 100k qps-month equivalent.
- Models: prefer open/quantized variants (llama-2/llama-3 family or equivalent). Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
- Security: VPC/private control plane, EU data residency for support transcripts, strict audit logs, BYOK/KMS for keys.
- Quote from call: "We need consistent 180ms retrieval and a reranker that actually improves top-5 — not just MTurk fluff."
- Internal stakeholders: Product (buyer), Platform/SRE (ops gate), Legal (data residency), CS leadership (value).
- Red flags: worried about ops complexity and warm cache behavior at scale.

requirements_summary: Need a RAG stack that can index 25M-50M support artifacts, serve high-QPS retrieval with reranking to surface top-5 items with >85% human-assessed relevance, maintain retrieval+rerank P95 <= 180ms, support VPC/private control plane, and provide cost modeling (cost per query) with recommendations for batching/quantization.
technical_constraints:
- Index update window: nightly full-snapshot + near-real-time delta for critical ticket updates.
- Storage preference: compressed vector store with support for efficient ANN (IVF/HNSW) and cold storage for older archives.
- Reranker: must be compatible with vector prefilter + lightweight transformer reranker (CPU or small GPU), acceptable to run rerank on CPU for cost reasons if latency holds.
- KV cache warmup: SRE requests clear guidance for cold-start P95 behavior and cache priming strategies.
evaluation_plan: Week 0-1: Ingest 5M sample; baseline retrieval latency and baseline Elastic rollup (customer provided)
Week 2-3: Run Redwood retrieval + ANN + 3 reranker variants (small transformer quantized) and measure top-5 MRR + P95 latency
Week 4: Cost simulation at 100k monthly queries and stress to 1k qps sustained for 30m to validate autoscale
Week 5-6: Security review + runbook handoff; customer scorecard for go/no-go
